standard_prerequisites.name: Left and right disjunction rules
standard_prerequisites.statement: Left-or derives (A or B) on the left from A on the left and from B on the left; Right-or derives (A or B) on the right from A (or from B) on the right.
standard_prerequisites.use: Item (1) combines the two Left-not derivations with a Left-or inference; item (2) uses Right-or on the initial sequents.

core_obligations: Statement (prop at 1038): (1) A or B, (not A), (not B) is inconsistent; (2) both A proves A or B and B proves A or B.

Item (1) (proof from 1045): a prooftree deriving A or B, (not A), (not B) sequent (empty): Left-not on A sequent A gives (not A), A sequent (empty), then double-line structural inferences produce A, (not A), (not B) sequent (empty); symmetrically for B; the two are joined by Left-or.
Item (2) (proof from 1064): two one-step derivations applying Right-or to A sequent A and to B sequent B, yielding A sequent A or B and B sequent A or B.
proof_roadmap: Witness item (1) with the two Left-not derivations joined by Left-or.
Witness both halves of item (2) with Right-or one-step derivations.
The first tree derives the empty right side, the second pair the stated provabilities.
difficulty_reason: Disjunction provability facts (statement 1038-1043, proof 1045-1076): the two-branch cut-free derivation with double-line structural shorthand carried in span; substantive steps are the Left-or join after the double-line weakening/contraction/exchange block. H2.
